scope: Descriptive outcome-linked source-correspondence sensitivity; no clinical accuracy or causal effect.
endpoint: Conservative worst-tied source-gene rank among genes with at least one PASSED allele; every exact source allele must be represented in that gene and PASSED. No phase or joint causality claim.
failure_rule: Preparation, missing-output, invalid-output and unrepresented/failed source-allele cases remain failures with reciprocal rank zero. Verified completed outputs from a terminal failed batch are retained alongside every missing failure.

definitions.all_linked_paper_completion: complete if every linked paper is complete in frozen summary; unreviewed if no linked paper has a record; otherwise incomplete.
definitions.all_linked_packet_completion: complete if every selected/alternate packet is adjudicated; unreviewed if none is adjudicated; otherwise incomplete.
definitions.all_linked_paper_and_packet_completion: complete only if both preceding criteria complete; unreviewed if no linked paper record; otherwise incomplete. Must reproduce frozen322completecase membership.
definitions.selected_categories: Use raw category/genotype/causal status only for adjudicated selected packets. No record or pending selected packet maps to explicitly unreviewed; raw pending labels remain in joined rows.
definitions.selected_phenotype_contradiction: present means at least one selected packet phenotypicFeatures assessment is contradicted; none_recorded means zero such recorded items in an adjudicated packet, not absence of true discrepancy. Phenotype-completeness status retained separately.
definitions.zero_size: Every declared category is emitted for every cohort, even n=0; rates null, never zero or NaN for empty denominators.
definitions.paired: Both arms for every member of each stratum, including failures. Both recovered/original only/none only/neither sum to paired n. Discordant n separately reported.
definitions.partition: Separate marginal strata for each named dimension, not a favorable intersection chosen from outcome results.
definitions.original_arm: original denotes original-HPO arm; none denotes no-HPO arm. Original literal pre-correction evaluation is separately retained without replacing corrected results.

limitations: Source audit and this linkage are post inference and not blinded; analysis has explicit per_case exposure.
Review availability/completion is nonrandom and depends on access and reader coverage; subgroup contrasts do not estimate effects of review or phenotypes.
Contradicted packet can be phenotype-only or formal classification mismatch; it is not a disproved diagnosis. No frozen label is substituted.
Full component reading does not mean every source assertion is supported or causal confidence established.
Source-derived phenotype inputs and source labels may share knowledge with current databases; this is not an independent temporal holdout.
Ten constructed input hypotheses can map to smaller/different passing universes; top10 may be trivial.
Cases cluster by gene/publication and include alternate packets; no independence assumption, inference p-values or clinical accuracy claims.
No new source reading credits, source adjudication changes, inference reruns, provider contact or repository edits.
